source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.1, written from the same printed pages 1-5 as the English lesson.

blocks.text: Biologists jandaron (living things) ko groups mein isliye rakhte hain ke un ke evolutionary rishtey (relationships) asaani se nazar aa sakein. 1969 mein American ecologist Robert Whittaker ne tamam jandaron ko paanch kingdoms mein baanta: Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae aur Animalia. Kingdom Monera mein prokaryotes thay, yani woh cells jin mein nucleus nahi hota. Baqi chaar kingdoms mein eukaryotes thay, yani woh cells jin mein nucleus hota hai.

1990 mein American microbiologist Carl Woese ne kaha ke prokaryotes ek group nahi hain. Us ne unhein do alag groups mein baanta: Archaea aur Bacteria. Isi buniyad par us ne tamam jandaron ko teen domains mein rakha: domain Archaea, domain Bacteria aur domain Eukarya. Archaea aur Bacteria dono prokaryotic hain, lekin kai baaton mein ek doosre se mukhtalif hain. Yeh system aaj 'three-domain system' kehlata hai.

blocks.title: Phylogeny
blocks.text: Jandaron ke darmiyan evolutionary rishta phylogeny kehlata hai. Jo diagram is rishtey ko dikhata hai use phylogenetic tree ya evolutionary tree kehte hain. Isey ek khandaani shajra (family tree) samjhein, jis mein qareebi rishtedar ek hi shaakh (branch) par hote hain.

blocks.alt: Ek evolutionary tree. Ek tana jis par Common Ancestor likha hai pehle do hisson mein batta hai: ek shaakh domain Bacteria ki taraf jaati hai; doosri shaakh aage ja kar domain Archaea aur domain Eukarya mein batti hai.
blocks.caption: Teen domains ka evolutionary tree (Figure 1.1 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Biologists ab yeh maante hain ke Archaea aur Bacteria ek common ancestor (saanjha jadd) se alag alag evolve huay. Molecular shawahid (evidence) batate hain ke archaea bacteria ki nisbat eukaryotes ke zyada qareeb hain. Textbook ke alfaaz mein, Eukarya Archaea se us waqt evolve hua jab archaea Bacteria se alag ho chuke thay.

blocks.text: Domain Archaea

Paanch-kingdom system mein yeh domain kingdom Monera ke andar tha. Archaea ka naam Greek lafz archaios se aaya hai, jis ka matlab hai 'qadeem' (ancient). Yeh prokaryotes hain jo bohat qadeem zamane mein bacteria se alag ho gaye thay. Ek archaean ka size 0.1 micrometre se le kar 15 micrometre se zyada tak ho sakta hai. Kuch archaea mil kar aggregates ya filaments (dhaage jaisi qataarein) banate hain jo 200 micrometre tak lambe ho sakte hain. In ki shaklein mukhtalif hoti hain: gol (spherical), chhari jaisi (rod-shaped), spiral, lobed aur mustateel (rectangular). Archaea asexual tareeqe se barhte hain: binary fission (ek cell ka do mein batna), multiple fission, fragmentation ya budding. Archaea mein mitosis aur meiosis nahi hote. Pehle inhein bacteria ka ek group samjha jata tha aur archaebacteria kaha jata tha.
Archaea alag kyun hain?

Cell membrane. Archaea ki cell membrane ke lipids mein glycerol aur fatty acid chains ke darmiyan ether linkage hota hai, aur fatty acid chains branched (shaakh-daar) hoti hain. Isi wajah se in ki membranes sakht halaat (extreme conditions) mein zyada mazboot (strong) rehti hain. Is ke baraks Bacteria aur Eukarya mein fatty acids glycerol ke saath ester linkage se jure hote hain, aur chains unbranched (seedhi) hoti hain.

blocks.alt: Do membrane lipid molecules saath saath. Baayein taraf archaeal lipid: glycerol head jis par phosphate group laga hai, aur do branched hydrocarbon chains jo ether linkage se juri hain. Daayein taraf bacterial ya eukaryotic lipid: wahi glycerol aur phosphate head, lekin do seedhi unbranched chains jo ester linkage se juri hain.
blocks.caption: Archaea ke membrane lipids ka Bacteria aur Eukarya se muqabla (Figure 1.2 ke mutabiq asal 3D model).
blocks.long_description: Dono lipids mein glycerol ki buniyad (backbone) hai jis par phosphate group laga hai. Archaeal lipid mein har chain ether linkage (carbon-oxygen-carbon) se juri hai aur chains par baqaida side branches hain. Bacterial aur eukaryotic lipid mein har chain ester linkage (carbon-oxygen-carbonyl) se juri hai aur chains seedhi hain.

fallback.text: Archaeal lipid: ether linkage, branched chains. Bacterial aur eukaryotic lipid: ester linkage, unbranched chains.
fallback.alt: Dono membrane lipids ke muqable ki rendered tasveer.

Membrane sakht halaat mein zyada mazboot rehti hai
Bacteria aur eukaryotes ki aam membrane

blocks.text: Cell wall ki banawat. Archaea ki cell walls mein cellulose aur peptidoglycan nahi hote. In ki jagah in mein alag qisam ke polysaccharides aur proteins hote hain; kuch archaea mein pseudopeptidoglycan hota hai. Bacteria ki cell walls mein peptidoglycan hota hai, jo sugars aur amino acids se bana ek polymer hai aur cell ko structural support deta hai. Eukarya mein agar cell wall ho to woh plants mein cellulose ki aur fungi mein chitin ki bani hoti hai.

Genetic farq. Archaea kai genetic sequences aur regulatory (control karne wali) khasoosiyat eukaryotes ke saath share karte hain. Isi se pata chalta hai ke evolution ke lihaz se archaea Eukarya ke zyada qareeb hain.

Metabolism. Archaea mein kuch khaas metabolic amal hote hain, jaise methanogenesis, yani methane gas banana. Yeh amal na bacteria mein hota hai na Eukarya mein. Bacteria mein photosynthesis, nitrogen fixation aur fermentation jaise metabolic raaste hote hain. Eukarya mein metabolism aksar zyada complex hota hai; is mein cellular respiration, photosynthesis (plants aur algae mein) aur mukhtalif qisam ki fermentation shamil hain.
Archaea ke bare groups

items: Methanogens apne metabolism ke nateeje mein methane gas banate hain.
Halobacteria bohat zyada namkeen (saline) mahol (environment) mein rehte hain.
Thermococci garam mahol mein paye jate hain.
Thaumarchaeota nitrogen cycle mein hissa lete hain.

blocks.title: Textbook mein do naam
blocks.text: Textbook ki figure mein archaea ke groups Methanogens, Halobacteria, Thermoplasmata aur Thermococci likhe hain, jabke paragraph mein Thermoplasmata ki jagah Thaumarchaeota ka naam hai. Chaar groups paragraph wale yaad rakhein, aur dono naam pehchaan lein agar kahin aayein.

blocks.title: Archaea ki ahmiyat
blocks.text: Jo archaea bohat zyada tezaabi (acidic) ya alkaline mahol mein rehte hain, un se aise enzymes milte hain jo sakht halaat mein bhi kaam karte hain. DNA replication ke enzymes aise archaea se nikale gaye hain; yeh zyada temperature par behtareen kaam karte hain aur laboratory mein DNA ki tez cloning mumkin banate hain. Methanogen archaea sewage treatment ka aham hissa hain: yeh anaerobic digestion karte hain aur biogas banate hain. Acidophilic archaea ko mineral processing mein ores se sona (gold), cobalt aur copper nikalne ke liye istemaal kiya jata hai. Insaan ki aanton (intestine) ki gas ka bara hissa methanogens ke metabolism ka nateeja hai.
Domain Bacteria
Paanch-kingdom system mein yeh domain bhi kingdom Monera mein tha. Yeh asal bacteria (true bacteria) hain. In mein kai aisi khasoosiyat hain jo inhein Archaea aur Eukarya se alag karti hain.

items: Cell structure (banawat): archaea ki tarah bacteria ke cells prokaryotic hote hain, yani asal nucleus nahi hota aur membrane-bound organelles bhi nahi hote.
Cell wall: deewar peptidoglycan ki bani hoti hai, ek khaas polymer jo cell ko support aur shakal deta hai.
Genetic material: ek hi gol (circular) DNA chromosome hota hai jo nucleoid region mein parha rehta hai.
Plasmids: aksar bacteria mein chhote gol DNA molecules hote hain jo ek bacterium se doosre mein ja sakte hain; is se genetic diversity aur adaptation mein madad milti hai.
Reproduction (afzaish): zyada tar asexual, binary fission se, jis mein ek cell do ek jaise (identical) daughter cells mein bat jata hai.
Ghiza (food) ke tareeqe (nutritional modes): autotrophs apni ghiza khud banate hain (jaise photosynthetic bacteria), aur heterotrophs organic maadde se ghiza lete hain (jaise decomposers).
Shakal (morphology): cocci (gol), bacilli (chhari jaisi), spirilla (spiral) aur vibrios (comma jaisi).
Tarteeb (arrangement): akele, joron mein (diplococci), zanjeer mein (streptococci), guchhon mein (staphylococci), ya species ke mutabiq (according to) kisi aur tarteeb mein.
Flagella: bohat se bacteria mein ek ya zyada flagella hote hain, yani chaabuk jaise dhaage jin se woh harkat karte hain.
Pili aur fimbriae: kuch bacteria mein baal jaisi banawatein jo satah (surface) se chipakne aur doosre bacteria se genetic material ke tabadle mein madad deti hain.

Respiration: bacteria obligate aerobes, obligate anaerobes, facultative anaerobes, microaerophiles ya aerotolerant anaerobes ho sakte hain. Kuch bacteria oxygen na hone par fermentation se energy banate hain.
Extremophiles: kuch bacteria sakht halaat mein phalte phoolte hain, jaise zyada garmi (thermophiles), zyada namak (halophiles) aur kam pH yani tezaab (acidophiles).
Pathogenicity (bimari phelana): kuch bacteria insaanon, janwaron aur podon mein toxins ya doosre virulence factors bana kar bimariyan paida karte hain.
Symbiosis: bohat se bacteria doosre jandaron ke saath rehte hain; mutualism mein dono ko faida hota hai, aur commensalism mein ek ko faida hota hai aur doosre ko nuqsan nahi hota.

blocks.alt: Chaar bacterial cells ka 3D model: ek gola (coccus), ek gol kinaron wali chhari (bacillus), ek mura hua comma jaisa cell (vibrio) aur ek pech-daar spiral (spirillum), har ek par label laga hai.
blocks.caption: Bacteria ki chaar buniyadi shaklein (Figure 1.4 ke mutabiq asal 3D model).
blocks.long_description: Cocci gol hote hain. Bacilli chhari jaise hote hain. Vibrios comma jaise, yani chhoti muri hui chhari. Spirilla spiral shakal ke hote hain. Yeh is lesson ke liye banaye gaye models hain, photographs nahi.

blocks.text: Bacteria ke bare groups
Domain Bacteria bohat se groups mein batta hai. Textbook ki misaalein:

items: Proteobacteria, misal ke taur par Escherichia coli, Rhizobium aur Helicobacter pylori.
Firmicutes, misal ke taur par Bacillus subtilis, Lactobacillus aur Clostridium botulinum.
Actinobacteria, misal ke taur par Streptomyces aur Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
Cyanobacteria, misal ke taur par Anabaena aur Spirulina.
Spirochaetes, misal ke taur par Treponema pallidum.
Acidobacteria, misal ke taur par Acidobacterium.
Aquificae, misal ke taur par Aquifex pyrophilus.

blocks.text: Domain Eukarya

Domain Eukarya mein woh tamam jandar shamil hain jin ke cells eukaryotic hain. Yeh cells Bacteria aur Archaea ke prokaryotic cells se buniyadi taur par mukhtalif hote hain. Neeche woh aam khasoosiyat hain jin ki wajah se Eukarya ko alag domain mana jata hai.

items: Cell structure: ek asal nucleus hota hai jo nuclear membrane mein band hota hai, aur membrane wale organelles hote hain, jaise mitochondria, chloroplasts (plants aur algae mein), endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus, lysosomes aur peroxisomes. Cell mein cytoskeleton bhi hota hai: microtubules, microfilaments aur intermediate filaments ka jaal jo cell ko support deta hai, harkat mumkin banata hai aur cell ke andar cheezon ko idhar udhar le jata hai.

Genetic material: DNA nucleus ke andar kai lambe seedhe (linear) chromosomes mein tarteeb diya hota hai. DNA histone proteins ke saath jura hota hai jo use munazzam (organised) aur control rakhne mein madad dete hain.

Reproduction: zyada tar eukaryotes sexual reproduction karte hain, jis mein meiosis aur fertilisation shamil hain; is se genetic diversity paida hoti hai. Kuch eukaryotes mitosis ke zariye asexual reproduction bhi karte hain, jis se bilkul ek jaisi (identical) aulad paida hoti hai.
Complex cellular organisation: multicellular eukaryotes mein cells mukhtalif qismon mein specialise ho kar tissues aur organs banate hain, jin ka apna apna kaam hota hai.

Evolutionary rishta: mana jata hai ke eukaryotes endosymbiosis se wajood (existence) mein aaye: ek host cell ne kuch prokaryotic cells ko nigal liya (jo baad mein mitochondria aur chloroplasts bane), aur dono ne saath rehna shuru kar diya.

blocks.text: Mukhtasir khulasa

items: Whittaker ke 1969 ke system mein paanch kingdoms thay aur tamam prokaryotes Monera mein thay.
Woese ke 1990 ke system mein teen domains hain: Archaea, Bacteria aur Eukarya. Archaea Bacteria ki nisbat Eukarya ke zyada qareeb hain.
Archaea bacteria se in baaton mein alag hain: ether linkage wale branched membrane lipids, peptidoglycan ke baghair cell wall, eukaryotes jaisi genetic khasoosiyat, aur methanogenesis.
Bacteria: peptidoglycan wall, ek gol chromosome, plasmids, binary fission, chaar shaklein aur kai tarteebein, flagella aur pili, mukhtalif respiration, extremophiles, pathogens aur symbionts.
Eukarya: asal nucleus, membrane wale organelles aur cytoskeleton, histones ke saath linear chromosomes, zyada tar sexual reproduction, tissues aur organs, aur endosymbiosis se aaghaz.

blocks.prompt: Peeche dekhe baghair teen domains ke naam likhein, aur do aisi khasoosiyat batayein jo Archaea ko Bacteria se alag karti hain.
blocks.explanation: Domains: Archaea, Bacteria aur Eukarya. In mein se koi do: ether linkage wale branched lipids ke muqable mein ester linkage wale unbranched lipids; peptidoglycan ke baghair wall ke muqable mein peptidoglycan wall; methanogenesis jo sirf archaea mein hoti hai; eukaryotes jaisi genetic khasoosiyat.
